fields.description: A certification a volunteer needs in order to be a candidate for this Terms of Reference. A Link to the society's own VMMS Certification Type, so no qualification is named in any source file: which certifications exist, how long they last and whether a lapse blocks deployment are all rows the society writes.
fields.label: Certification Type

fields.description: Whether this requirement is a hard filter or a preference. On, and a volunteer who does not hold the certification (or whose certification has lapsed on the date being asked about) is not a candidate at all. Off, and it is desirable rather than required: the volunteer is still a candidate, and holding it ranks them higher. Read by deployment/services/matching.py, which computes the lapse rather than reading a stored flag.
fields.label: Mandatory

fields.description: Why this requirement is here, for whoever reads the Terms of Reference. Never read by code.
fields.label: Notes
